facts.label: Work authorization

paragraphs: I got into programming as a teenager back in 2020 — starting out self-taught, through YouTube and books, and that hobby grew into a profession. Today I'm a full-stack developer who builds complete, production-minded systems — authentication, payments, race-condition-safe transactions, CI/CD — not just isolated features. I hold a B.Sc. in Computer Science with honors from Zaporizhzhia Polytechnic National University. Currently open to full-time full-stack opportunities.

My university is rated H+ in Anabin (equivalent to a German university), though formal recognition (Anerkennung) of my specific degree is still pending. I have full, unrestricted access to the German labor market — no visa sponsorship needed. I'm based in Berlin and certified at German B2 level.

Rather than stopping at tutorials, I build complete, non-trivial projects to learn: an e-commerce platform with test-mode payments and CI/CD, a local AI voice assistant, a legal-form digitization tool, and a crypto paper-trading simulator focused on financial precision and race-condition safety.

My Bachelor's thesis explored algorithms for license plate recognition under difficult weather conditions — a first deep dive into computer vision that shaped how I think about robustness in software.
